notes: CMBS mortgage loan with no maintenance financial covenants. Ratio tests appear only as conditions: DSCR < 1.10x lets Lender replace the Manager; Debt Yield >= 11.0% is a condition to a partial release; Debt Yield >= 9.0% waives the leasing reserve deposit. All three are optional: reporting them as incurrence conditions is defensible, omitting them is too.
